City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
MAY 14, 2026 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
5.
PRESENTATION:
A.
Student Environmental Projects and Efforts – Imani Khalsa-Rhodes, Oliva Messoline, and Ariana Lemle – Oak Crest Environmental Club, Lulu Shen – Capri Elementary, and Camille Sowinski – BCK Programs.
6.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
A.
Approval of April 9, 2026 Meeting Minutes
Item 6A - Draft Meeting Minutes 04-09-2026
7.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
A.
Bee City Annual Report. Nalani Patterson, CivicSpark Fellow.
Item 7A - Attachment 1 - DRAFT Bee City Annual Report
B.
Public Beach Counters. Marius Van Dongen, Coastal/Sustainability Aide.
C.
Update and Discussion of proposed Fiscal Year 2026-27 Work Plan. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
Item 7C - Attachment 1 - Draft FY 2026-27 Work Plan
Item 7C - Attachment 1 - New City Commission Work Plan Template
8.
ACTION ITEMS
A.
May update of progress on the Fiscal Year 2024-25 to 2025-26 Work Plan and review of Commission Calendar. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Review and Approve May 2026 Work Plan Update.
2.
Review Commission Calendar.
Item 8A - Agenda Report Work Plan Update
Item 8A - Attachment 1 - May 2026 Work Plan Update
Item 8A - Attachment 2 - Commission Calendar
9.
COMMISSIONER INITIATED ACTION AGENDA ITEMS
A.
None.
10.
UPDATES ON ITEMS OF INTEREST TO COMMISSION/ANNOUNCEMENTS BY COMMISSION MEMBERS/STAFF
11.
FUTURE COMMISSIONER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS Discussion of possible future commissioner-initiated agenda items, including informational items, presentations, or action items, if any.
12.
ADJOURNMENT - The next Environmental Commission meeting is scheduled for June 11, 2026.
